You, the one who conquers this sacred land, in control over both Shadow and Light. May all your enemies bow before the might of your Shadow Army.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Soulscape - Killing any entity will allow their soul to linger for a short period of time. The user has 30 seconds to choose whether or not to keep this entity or it will disappear forever. See [Shadow Warrior].
Passive: [Passive, True] Essence of Eclipse - Your shadows grow restless. All Shadow Warriors gain increased damage and speed during the night and gain armor and armor toughness in the day. Does not affect the player, unless a specific condition is met. See [Shadow Merge].
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Rewrite Fate - Any deaths that the user may take are rewritten at the cost of 25% of the user's MP (20% on mastery). The user will then teleport to a random location next to the target. Susano'o Fantasy Destruction overwrites this and outright kills you.
Active
[Active, Press] Shadow Warrior - Pressing the mode while looking at a lingering soul will create a Shadow Warrior version of the mob you killed, at the cost of the target's EP before you killed them. No longer consumes Maximum MP, but instead Current MP. Yes, includes Otherworlders but not bosses. Shadow Warriors are loyal to the player and act like a permanent subordinate.
Active: [Active, Press] Shadow Storage - Store any subordinate you are looking at into an item. Right click the ground to re-summon them.
Active: [Active, Press] Shadow Merge - While holding any of your shadow warrior subordinates in item form, pressing the skill key will allow you to harness their abilities, meaning their stats are added onto yours. Their max EP is added to your EP while Merge is happening. Pressing Shadow Merge again while merged will give you the original subordinate back in item form. Dying will make you permanently lose this subordinate.
While Merged, Essence of Eclipse applies to you as well.

Boost the power of Lightning and water abilities by a great amount.

Passive
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Boost - All lightning and Water abilities/spells do 8x more damage (doesnt stack with Water manipulation/domination and Lightning manipulation/domination)

Summon a violent gravitational black hole that pulls everything into a singularity.

Information
Type: Lord
Obtaining a Spirit: Spirit Lord Of Earth
Cost: 500,000MP
Cast Time: 400 Ticks
Points to Master: 10000
Cooldown: 420 seconds, reduced to 300 seconds when mastered.

Effect
[Active - Press] Gravitational Void: On activation, summon a violent gravitational black hole. Nearby blocks and targets are pulled into its center. Targets being pulled by the black hole gain Slowness 1.

Upon reaching the center, blocks are deleted. The more blocks and entities the black hole absorbs, the bigger its size becomes, up to a maximum size of 10.

The black hole bypasses resistances, barriers, and dodge. The bigger the black hole, the more damage it deals. It initially starts at 50 Gravity / 50 Magic damage, but can scale up to 250 Gravity / 250 Magic damage at maximum.

The black hole lasts for one minute. Crouching before using the skill removes the black hole.

Mastery Bonus
Cooldown reduced to 5 minutes.
Cost decreased to 300,000MP.
The black hole lasts for three minutes.
Cast time decreased to 120 ticks.

Read the traces of the environment with a keen nose, briefly gaining Earthen Sense.

Information
Type: Extra Skill
Obtain Cost: 1,000 MP
Points to Learn: 100
Points to Master: 500
Player Obtainable: Yes
Passive Toggle: No

Obtaining
Unknown. Also available through copying or stealing.

Passive
Effect: When activated and held, grants Earthen Sense to the user for 10 seconds. Mastery extends the duration to 15 seconds. While active, it automatically provides environmental sensing. Costs 15 MP per second.

Active
[Active - Hold] Earthen Sense: Maintains the Earthen Sense effect. Automatically deactivates if the user runs out of Magicules or after the duration ends. Adds Mastery points every 3 seconds while held.

[Active - Release] Early Deactivation: Deactivates the skill early and triggers a cooldown. Cooldown is 60 seconds, or 30 seconds when mastered.

Notes / Mechanics
Duration Base: 10 seconds (10 x 20 ticks).
Duration Master: 15 seconds.
Cooldown Base: 60 seconds.
Cooldown Master: 30 seconds.
Magicule Cost per Second: 15 MP.

Use smithing techniques to work equipment, and increase work speed while enough Magicules remain.

Information
Type: Intrinsic Skill
Obtain Cost: 100 MP
Points to Master: 100
Player Obtainable: Yes
Race: Dwarf

Obtaining
Copying / Stealing.

Active
[Active - Press] Smithing Bench: Opens a Smithing Bench menu for the player. Can only be used if the skill is mastered. Adds Mastery points on use. Cooldown: 60 seconds, or 30 seconds when mastered.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Haste: When toggled on, applies the Haste effect as long as the player has enough Magicules. Automatically toggles off if the player runs out of Magicules. Can only be toggled when mastered.

Notes / Mechanics
Cooldown Base: 60 seconds.
Cooldown Master: 30 seconds.
Magicule Cost per Tick: 30.
Only applies effects if the skill is toggled and the player has Magicules.

Record defeated powerful entities and temporarily imitate their strength.

Information
Type: Unique Skill
Obtain Cost: 75,000 MP
Points to Master: 1000
Player Obtainable: Yes
Race: Any

Obtaining
Other: Reincarnation / Skill Reroll.

Active
[Active - Press] Imitator Menu: Opens the Imitator menu, allowing the player to view and select entities they have previously defeated. A cooldown of 30 minutes starts when the user imitates an entity.

Notes / Mechanics
Collects a list of all imitable entities the player has killed, including entities from mods like Mysticism or Not Enough Bosses if loaded.

Only displays entities the player has at least 1 kill of.

When imitating an entity, the player can temporarily gain that entity's Unique Skill.

Devour the form of all things, cast every soul into imaginary space, and turn all existence into your own power.

Acquisition
Skill Fusion: fused from Gluttony and Merciless.
Prerequisites: mastered Gluttony and mastered Merciless.
Race requirement: Hero Egg, True Hero, Demon Lord Egg, or True Demon Lord.
After all conditions are met, fusion occurs automatically. Gluttony and Merciless disappear, and Beelzebub replaces them.
Beelzebub cannot be unlocked manually with Magicules.
By default, only one player on a server can own Beelzebub at a time. This limit can be disabled by server settings.

Passive
[Passive - Always Active] Endless Stomach: Permanently increases water and lava storage capacity. This effect is always active while the holder owns Beelzebub, and Beelzebub does not have a toggleable passive checkbox.

[Passive - Slot Bound] Soul Consume: When Beelzebub is bound to the selected active slot, the holder's attacks apply Soul Drain to living targets if enough Magicules are available. Soul Consume does not directly increase attack damage; it adds a soul-draining effect to the target.

Active
[Active - Hold] Predation: A strengthened version of Gluttony's devouring ability. While held, Beelzebub devours enemies, blocks, items, EP, and skills in front of the holder. The devouring range can be adjusted and grows wider as the skill becomes stronger. After mastery, Predation gains better range, higher damage, and shorter cooldowns.

[Active - Press] Imaginary Space: Opens Beelzebub's exclusive imaginary storage. This storage is separate from Gluttony's original storage and is much larger. When Beelzebub is created through fusion, the contents of Gluttony's old storage are transferred into Beelzebub's Imaginary Space. Storage capacity increases with mastery.
Shift + Press on a living creature attempts to capture it into Imaginary Space as a Captured Entity item. Captured creatures can be released later by using the item. Players, bosses, villagers, and wandering traders cannot be captured. If the release position is blocked, the creature is not released, and the item is safely returned. Server settings can disable creature capture.

[Active - Press] Isolation: Removes harmful effects from the holder. If the holder's main hand is empty, Isolation cleanses negative status effects such as Poison, Weakness, Wither, and Slowness. If the holder is holding a dissolvable item, Beelzebub devours it and converts it into Magicules and health. After mastery, Isolation costs less and has a shorter cooldown.

[Active - Hold] Corrosion: Surrounds the holder with a dissolving aura. While held, nearby enemies take continuous corrosion damage, and Beelzebub releases additional corrosion waves. While active, Corrosion also increases the holder's movement speed. After mastery, Corrosion consumes fewer Magicules and has a shorter cooldown.

[Active - Press] Receive: Targets one subordinate and copies skills they have mastered. Temporary skills, unmastered skills, protected skills, and certain protected races cannot be transferred. After mastery, Receive has a shorter cooldown.

[Active - Hold] Soul Steal: A strengthened form of Merciless. While held, Beelzebub releases soul-draining power around the holder. Nearby enemies may be consumed if they are weakened, have lower EP than the holder, or are affected by fear. Consumed enemies take massive soul damage and are usually killed instantly. Creative-mode invulnerable players are ignored.
